clips.title: The story
paras: Inside Stormwind Keep, Tyrion watches the court and aids covert work. The gnome works with Elling Trias to gather intelligence and counter plots against the kingdom.
Tyrion keeps to the halls of Stormwind Keep, watching the palace and staying in touch with contacts beyond official oversight.

Elling Trias, a cheese merchant in the Trade District, trusts Tyrion with sensitive matters. Trias runs a discreet information network and sends reliable operatives to Tyrion when the House of Nobles' bureaucracy must be bypassed.
